purpose: Replication of the position, temporal-history, and full-mix contrasts on an independent set of MUSDB18 train tracks and LibriSpeech speakers.
tracks: Angela Thomas Wade - Milk Cow Blues
Atlantis Bound - It Was My Fault For Waiting
Clara Berry And Wooldog - Waltz For My Victims
Faces On Film - Waiting For Ga
Jokers, Jacks & Kings - Sea Of Leaves

temporal_history.endpoint: intersection-union: window speech_exclusive_recall up AND lyric_exclusive_recall down

statistics.sign_flip: exact two-sided sign-flip tests on the track axis (n=26 requires sampling 2^26>2^20; use 100,000 sampled sign assignments) and the utterance axis (2^15 exact)
statistics.correction: none; replication set, reported alongside, not pooled with, the primary confirmatory family

description: Independent replication tracks, speakers, and experiment settings used in the paper.
